alex: quick heads-up — small revert + fix to the batcher heuristics. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/512

alex: TL;DR: revert accidental change to `max_batch_delay` and add a guard to avoid negative batch window under low QPS. Added unit test and a simple integration smoke for the batcher loop. Hoping to merge during low-traffic window tonight (~00:30 UTC). can someone take a quick look? cc @maria @josh

maria: will take a look in ~20m

josh: quick q — does this touch kv prefetch or attention kernels? want to know if we need extra rollout steps

alex: not touching kv prefetch or attn kernels; pure batching timing change. no model-serving interface changes.

sam: left one comment about the test harness cleanup, otherwise LGTM

alex: addressed your comment and pushed a fix — ptal @sam

maria: skimmed the diff, looks fine to me. one nit about a log level but not blocking

josh: approved, ran the unit tests locally and they pass for me

ci-bot: Build #4872 succeeded ✅ — all tests passed: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4872

alex: awesome. can someone merge around 00:30 UTC and run the smoke check? I'll watch metrics. smoke command:

```
./scripts/smoke_runtime.sh --target batcher --timeout 120
```

alex: smoke routine checks: ensure tail latency (< 200ms) and no batcher errors in logs (`grep -i "batcher error" /var/log/runtime.log`)

nate: I can merge and run the smoke at 00:30 UTC. ping me if anything spikes

alex: perfect — tagging merge window. will coordinate rollout and rollback steps if needed :thumbsup:

sam: thanks all
